selection_A: first strictly highest validation Macro-F1; patience resets on Micro or Macro improvement
selection_B: same weights as A; eight child-logit offsets selected on validation only
decoder_B_tie_break: smallest absolute offset; stable label index at equal adjusted score
test_policy: No test inference until all five full seeds converge by source early stopping, protocol remains frozen and budget permits export. Existing benchmark is retrospective.
source_reproduction_gate: Open: recovered WoS validation is verified; published test scores not reproduced. No source-score replication claim.
diagnostic_admission: Passed fresh full HGCLR author-RNG 6000-update text-dependence diagnostic, memorization pair and full-BERT gradient/update parity. Previous failed runs retained.
initialization: Pinned BERT pretrained; fresh HGCLR modules/optimizer for every seed; no reuse of diagnostic checkpoints or seed+100 reseeding.
dropout_rng: Corrected unused embedding dropout draw; full-BERT train/gradient/Adam parity verified.
source_initialization_limit: Author-style normal initialization distribution for used heads; random draw order of module construction need not reproduce author seed3 bit for bit.
seed_policy: Five predeclared manuscript seeds, executed in order; unfinished seeds retained and reported as incomplete. No replacement or best-seed selection.
source_F1_threshold: torch.sigmoid(FP32 logits)>0.5, including sigmoid rounding at zero
taxonomy_policy: Original taxonomy and label assets preserved byte-for-byte; no description, class or hierarchy edits.
